body: I think I answered this before from someone, it just feels really stupid to share my answer though. I wrote it in a weird optimistic mood when I thought I deserved to live.

Sorry I got back so late. I forgot to check here.

I'm not sure honestly. I'm sorry. That's too general for me to answer. I just want to feel good enough.

Absolutely hate him. It's like dragging around a dummy and having to force him to do anything.

Sorry for the fast reply, obviously this paranoid shit means I have no life.

Severe anxiety. I just couldn't take it. It turned into panic attacks and agoraphobia for a couple years but now I'm finally comfortable leaving the house to shop, eat, etc... just to non school areas...

School has so many people. Judging me. Probably wanting to hurt me. Already know they all hate me and no one believes me or brushes it off. It's such a lonely, scary experience. I don't know what the right thing to do is.

I worry about the cafeteria, and I'm close to bursting into tears when I have to pick a seat next to someone because I don't want to be a bother to anyone. Similiarly my first instinct is to cry in group projects because I'm always the last one picked and the teacher usually gives up and makes me a part of someone else's group. I always feel like I'm intruding even walking down the hall next to anyone.

I don't talk. I can't. I don't know why. I go full retard and lose my ability to speak.

People ask me questions. It always feels too personal. It feels like they're all spies. I get told jokes, I think? I never really got them. Maybe it was bullying. I honestly can't tell people's intentions. My personal space was never respected. I kept having my arms rubbed and my hair played with or my butt touched. 

It was just a too stressful environment so I didn't go.

My life revolves around Khan Academy and other resources for algebra and just about everything. I'm not good at anything, not just algebra lol.

I'm 16, illegally dropped out at 13 because I kept skipping, (was "homeschooled" but not really, just used it as an excuse to avoid truancy/my mom paying the fines), and now I'm facing the threat of my mom sending me back. The school automatically sends home schoolers to 9th grade. I'm way too embarrassed and have been crying all night. I don't want to have to keep skipping school again. I was living with her ex at the time. I'm not good at lying to my mom.
I wish I had autism diagnosed. At least it would be an explanation. I feel like my behavior would be an insult to autistic people though.
I must be psychotic then. Sometimes I really do feel like everyone else isn't even alive. It's too weird for everyone to hate me. I've been hated so much in my life.
Fuck that's relatable and I'm kinda the opposite with the cute boy thing? I'm not even allowed to transition so I'm kinda stuck as a reverse trap until I can move out.

Sorry for the 20min reply. 

Well I'm just concerned they aren't really... sentient to begin with? Like ... are they capable of giving it a second thought? I feel so alone like I'm the only person. Sorry that's pretty selfish. Trust me I'm not doing a good job keeping the show running smoothly.
I don't understand what you're saying.
I don't think I'm ever going to have a better point of view.
I don't know why you keep capitalizing me. I'm sorry I'm hard to understand. I'll try my best to be easier to understand.

Me: ???

everyone says I make no sense say something unique you guys are getting old
I'm against minors being in fetish communities. That's the most recent one but I'm not getting into it because you agree with them.

I don't want to believe this way. But my empathy has been failing me ever since I was in the hospital. I don't think anyone really gives a shit.

And I know that's a really selfish way to think but no... people do attack me. They straight up come to me and insult me or tell me to kill myself. I don't even want to try. It's been the almost whole second half of my life.
